تختطون (form VIII)
# تَخْتَطُونَ (taḵtaṭūna) /tax.ta.tˤuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِخْتَطَى (iḵtaṭā)
# تُخْتَطَوْنَ (tuḵtaṭawna) /tux.ta.tˤaw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَطَى (iḵtaṭā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
